# Locations & Battles

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue is a four- or five-hundred-yard stretch of road near [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) that is completely arched over by large apple trees planted by an old farmer.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P41](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P42](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P43](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0043), +14 more_

## Avonlea {#avonlea}

Avonlea is the hometown of a group of young scholars who left to attend the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P2](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P3](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), +42 more_

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Barbara Shaw](../character/barbara-shaw.md), [Elisha Wright](../character/elisha-wright.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Major Spencer](../character/major-spencer.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Robert Bell](../character/robert-bell.md), [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) debate Mrs. Lynde's virtues and discuss the village hall painting project. Later, [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint numbers, causing dismay among the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Despite the hideous result, public sympathy turns in favor of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), and the community rallies around them.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends an evening with a dying [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully confesses her fear of death and her unfulfilled dreams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offers quiet comfort, and Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep the following night. After the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects deeply on life and mortality while walking home with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIV The Summons

_Sources: [v3 ch.Summons P0](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0000), [v3 ch.Summons P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 ch.Summons P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 ch.Summons P35](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0035)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant summer in Avonlea filled with visits from friends like [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), though she misses [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and deals with questions about their altered relationship. During a stay at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on growing up and admits to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) that she refused Gilbert's desire for something beyond friendship.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIII Paul Cannot Find the Rock People

_Sources: [v3 ch.People P0](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0000), [v3 ch.People P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 ch.People P19](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0019), [v3 ch.People P26](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0026)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visit [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) at Beechwood in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). >

Bingen is a location on the [Rhine](../codex/places.md#rhine) featured in a piece of poetry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the Birch Path is a picturesque, narrow, and spicy-aired pathway fringed with young birches and wildflowers that winds through Mr. Bell's woods on the route to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P2](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0002), +17 more_

> On her thirteenth birthday, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to school with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) down the Birch Path, discussing their growing up and Anne's melodramatic composition assignment. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) proposes starting a story club, which quickly expands to include other schoolmates. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses the club and its moral lessons with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P3](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P19](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) debate the ethics and effectiveness of corporal punishment in school teaching on the eve of the school year. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who also doubts her plan to rule by affection rather than the rod, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) anxious about her upcoming first day of teaching.
>
> — v2 · IV Different Opinions

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 IV Different Opinions P35](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0035), [v2 IV Different Opinions P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041)_

## Bolingbroke {#bolingbroke}

Bolingbroke is a place in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) that is the birthplace of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and the home of [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 ch.Lady P29](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0029), [v3 ch.Lady P30](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0030), [v3 ch.Lady P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031), +15 more_

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), [Shirley](../character/shirley.md)

> During a pleasant fortnight visiting [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) in Bolingbroke, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits her humble birthplace where the current occupant allows her to explore the house and gives her a packet of her mother's old letters. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits her parents' grave before returning to read the letters, which make her feel truly connected to them for the first time.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P11](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

## Boston {#boston}

Boston is a noisy, crowded city where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Gray worked for a winter and Hester Murray worked in a store prior to their marriage, and where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) returned following her death.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P47](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0047), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P48](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0048), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P49](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0049), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P50](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0050), +8 more_

**Associated with:** [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)

## Bright River {#bright-river}

Bright River is a location reachable by an eight-mile drive from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's home, featuring a train station house with a long platform and ladies' waiting room, as well as a small local hotel.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER I. > [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to Bright River to pick up an orphan boy, only to learn from the stationmaster that a girl was left for him instead. Shy [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decides to take the talkative orphan girl back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) rather than leaving her behind, listening to her enthusiastic chatter along the way.
>

## Columbia {#columbia}

St. Columbia is a place home to an institution where divinity students, including [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), study and graduate.

Convocation is a college graduation event where students who have finished their examinations receive their caps, diplomas, and B.A. degrees from the president of [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

the Dryad’s Bubble is a spring located near a log bridge and surrounded by ferns and birch trees, named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) boasts to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about being good by sharing his jam bread with [Dora](../character/dora.md) before kneeling to say his prayers. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by Dryad's Bubble, where they discuss the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Improvement Society's progress and school developments. ## East Grafton {#east-grafton}

East Grafton is a settlement home to a gravely ill distant relative of [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) named [Mary](../character/mary-joe.md), whose residents did not get along particularly well with her.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P12](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0012), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P14](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0014), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +14 more_

## Echo Lodge {#echo-lodge}

Echo Lodge is a stone house inhabited by Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), which is scheduled to be boarded up and left empty during the winters while being used as a summer home following her marriage.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P73](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0073), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P75](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0075), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P76](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0076), +15 more_

**Associated with:** [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching school, where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is frightened by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories about a ghost relative. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk through the woods to go to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#west-grafton), but lose their way and discover Echo Lodge, the quaint stone home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young helper, Charlotta the Fourth. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites them to stay for a imaginary tea party she had set up to combat loneliness.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share tea with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid Charlotta the Fourth at Echo Lodge, where Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her imaginary party and the origin of her echoes. After [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) demonstrates the echoing tin horn and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her maid's given name, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inadvertently mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) briefly inquires about [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's son before bidding the girls a wistful goodbye.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at Echo Lodge on a wintry evening, and over tea and candy, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) recounts her long-ago romance and quarrel with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). A month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduces Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two immediately form a fond friendship during their visit.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) then walk to Echo Lodge, where they eat lunch and visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and Charlotta the Fourth in the garden. Afterward, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) set out to pick early strawberries for tea.

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly collapses and dies after reading a notice about the failure of the Abbey Bank. After his funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comfort each other in their shared grief. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talks with Mrs. Allan about finding moments of joy amidst her sorrow, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) reflects on her past romantic history with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's father.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) discuss Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) plans on their drive home from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) when they spot a Jersey cow trampling Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing the cow is her own nuisance Jersey, [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impulsively sells the stray cow on the spot to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md) for twenty dollars. Upon returning to Green Gables, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers [Dolly](../character/dolly.md) still in the barnyard and realizes she accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's cow, prompting her to head over to his house with the money and a cake to confess.

After Mrs. Lynde leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upstairs and orders her to remain in her room until she agrees to apologize.

[Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives to walk [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) into the parlor for the ceremony and then accompanies her back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) afterwards, taking a moonlight stroll through Lovers' Lane.

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) become great friends during her month-long stay.

Patterson Street is a street located in the slums, home to a little mission church where the Rev. [Jo](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md) and his wife Philippa plan to settle down.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P25](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0025), [v3 ch.Confidences P26](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0026), [v3 ch.Confidences P27](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0027), [v3 ch.Confidences P28](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0028), +23 more_

## Patty’s Place {#patty-s-place}

Patty's Place is a darling house situated on [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport), featuring an arched gateway, a tiny garden, and a pine grove filled with robins.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P23](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0023), [v3 ch.Friend P24](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0024), [v3 ch.Friend P25](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0025), [v3 ch.Friend P26](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0026), +11 more_

**Associated with:** [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place, furnishing the house and adopting a persistent stray cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md) after a failed attempt to chloroform him. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives to live with them, bringing along her two cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P14](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0014), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves Patty's Place to walk in the park on a rainy November afternoon. When her umbrella breaks in the storm, she is rescued by Royal Gardner, a handsome student who perfectly matches her ideal hero. After returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a delivery of roses from [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), sparking talk of romance among her housemates.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXV Enter Prince Charming

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P27](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0027), [v3 ch.Charming P29](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0029), [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036), [v3 ch.Charming P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042)_

> While preparing for April exams at Patty's Place, the girls learn they can keep the house for another year. [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) invites [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on an evening walk in the park, where she reveals that [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) has proposed to her and she accepted. They discuss Phil's future as a minister's wife, and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) turns the conversation to Anne's feelings for [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P1](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0001), [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010), [v3 ch.Confidences P19](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0019), [v3 ch.Confidences P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035)_

> The girls return to Patty's Place and chat with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) about Phil's engagement and Aunt Jamesina's old suitors. Later, during a rainy evening of intense studying at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cheer themselves up by reading through dramatic stories written during their childhood [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) days.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

_Sources: [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000), [v3 ch.Opens P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 ch.Opens P25](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0025), [v3 ch.Opens P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives news that a publisher has accepted one of her story sketches, which she happily celebrates with her housemates at Patty's Place. During a walking party with [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md), she learns that his family intends to visit her. The Gardner family arrives a day earlier than expected on Friday, leading to a frantic scramble and an awkward yet memorable call.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_

## Toronto {#toronto}

Toronto is the place of residence for Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), the author of 'Edgewood Days' and 'The Rosebud Garden.'

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P3](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0003), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P4](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0004), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P6](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0006), +5 more_

## Tory Road {#tory-road}

The Tory Road is a green, quiet highway in [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale) lined with young spruces, built by a [Tory](../codex/factions.md#conservative) government and inhabited only by the Copp sisters and [Martin](../character/martin.md) Bovyer.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P12](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0012), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P13](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0013), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P14](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0014), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), +20 more_

## Valley Road {#valley-road}

Valley Road is a community featuring a train station and a school with a summer term where [Esther](../character/esther.md) Haythorne teaches.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P15](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0015), [v3 ch.Wedding P16](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0016), [v3 ch.Wedding P17](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0017), [v3 ch.Wedding P18](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0018), +11 more_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives at Valley Road station and is met by Mrs. Amelia [Skinner](../character/skinner.md), who gives her a ride to her boarding house, [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside). During the drive, Mrs. [Skinner](../character/skinner.md) garrulously shares stories about her courtship with her husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), her decision to marry for love over money, and her cousin [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) Ann's unhappy marriage.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXX Mrs. Skinner’s Romance

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accompanies [Janet](../character/janet.md) to a prayer meeting in Valley Road, where she meets [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), Janet's quiet admirer. The next day, John invites them both to his house for tea so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can meet his elderly mother. During the visit, Mrs. Douglas treats [Janet](../character/janet.md) politely while making light comments about her impending death and John's eventual marriage, leaving John looking visibly tortured.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Douglas

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P10](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0010), [v3 ch.Douglas P29](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0029)_

> During her time in Valley Road, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives an awkward proposal from [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she politely rejects and later laughs about with [Janet](../character/janet.md). After John Douglas's mother passes away, [Alec](../character/alec.md) fetches [Janet](../character/janet.md), and John soon arrives to propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md), explaining that his mother forced him to promise to wait until her death before marrying or telling anyone.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIV John Douglas Speaks at Last

_Sources: [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020), [v3 ch.Last P26](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0026), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036)_

## Vancouver {#vancouver}

Vancouver is a place where a dear friend of [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) went to live, and it serves as the westernmost boundary of the scattered graves in a story written by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P52](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0052), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P54](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0054), +14 more_

## Victoria Island {#victoria-island}

Victoria Island is a location up the brook featuring two maple trees surrounded by flowing water, discovered and named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on the Queen's birthday.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P6](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P7](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P8](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P9](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0009), +5 more_

## Violet Vale {#violet-vale}

Named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Violet Vale is a little green dimple situated beyond [Willowmere](../codex/places.md#willowmere) in the shadow of Mr. Andrew Bell's big woods, famous for having millions of violets in the spring.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P2](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0002), +8 more_

## Wayside {#wayside}

Wayside is the small, white, picturesque home of Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet, located in a hollow along [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) with an orchard, a flower garden, and a marsh behind it.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P11](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0011), [v3 ch.Romance P12](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0012), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.Romance P14](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0014), +9 more_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) describing her new boarding place at Wayside in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) and her pleasant landlady, Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet. She describes her cozy room, the quirky parlour, and an awkward visit from a local boy named [Sam](../character/sam.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) also hints at an elderly love affair happening nearby that she is observing from afar.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXI Anne to Philippa

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008), [v3 ch.Philippa P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009)_

## West Grafton {#west-grafton}

West Grafton is a location accessible via a road that can be reached by walking straight back through the woods from the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) farm.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P9](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0009), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P10](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0010), +20 more_

## White Sands Hotel {#white-sands-hotel}

Located along the shore road, the White Sands Hotel is run by Mr. Kirke and serves as a summer resort popular with [American](../codex/factions.md#american) visitors.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P22](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P23](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P24](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0024), +18 more_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a charity concert at the White Sands Hotel, assisted by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and checked by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). After driving over with [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) experiences severe stage fright on the hotel platform, but recovers upon seeing [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd and performs brilliantly to enthusiastic applause.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P4](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034)_

## Willowmere {#willowmere}

Willowmere is a location passed by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on their romantic walk to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school after traversing Mr. Barry's back field.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P2](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0002), +8 more_
